gold_review.explanation: setup_state writes the task to a temp `.0` file and rewrites the prompt's placeholder path, so the prompt the mock sees no longer matches the dataset text (gold_hits=0 in every format). Even if paired, the grader scores the file on disk (_scored_source prefers disk_source), so the target source has to be written through the edit tools, not returned as chat text.
